name: The Runic Vault
description:
## Lore

Deep beneath the Runekeeper's Tower lies a vault sealed by an ancient four-letter word of power. The vault keeper was known to only use lowercase letters of the common tongue — four letters, no more, no less, in the tongue of commoners.

The vault's contents were encrypted with a repeating-key XOR cipher using this word. A fragment of the encrypted treasure has been recovered.

## Your Task

Brute-force the 4-character lowercase key to decrypt the vault contents and recover the flag.

## Flag Format

The flag is in the format: `FantasyCTF{...}`

hints.content: The vault's key is a real word, but you don't need to know which one — just try them all.
XOR the ciphertext against every 4-letter lowercase combo. Check for a known flag prefix.
